skill.summary: Automate common Notion database operations like batch page creation, data filtering, content generation, and export. Use when you need to automate workflows...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Notion database automation skill.
- Automate querying, batch page creation, updating, and exporting Notion databases.
- Supports all major Notion property types (including relations and rollups).
- Includes scripts for bulk data import/export, template-based database setup, and common workflow automation.
- Simple Python interface with ready-to-use examples and templates.
- Designed for rapid workflow automation, backup, and analytics use cases.
